name: brotli-decoder
purpose: Decode Brotli-compressed EDK II UEFI GUID-defined sections.
local_changes: CMake builds a static decoder-only target; encoder and shared-dictionary source files are not compiled.
HexLab supplies a custom decoder allocator capped by the guided payload scratch declaration and a 32 MiB hard ceiling.
HexLab feeds and drains the decoder in 64 KiB steps with cancellation checks, exact output sizing, compressed-tail rejection, and global decode budgets.
